description: Create a custom API tool that the bot can invoke during conversations to fetch external data or trigger actions.

botId.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the bot to create the tool for

config.description: Tool configuration specifying the endpoint and request details

asyncConfig.description: Configuration for async submit-poll-download APIs like fal.ai and Replicate

jobIdPath.description: Dot-notation path to extract job ID from initial response (e.g. 'id', 'request_id')

maxPollingMs.description: Maximum time to poll before timeout (default: 120000)

pollingEndpoint.description: URL template with {{jobId}} placeholder for polling job status

resultPath.description: Dot-notation path to extract final result from completed response (e.g. 'output')

statusPath.description: Dot-notation path to status field in poll response (e.g. 'status')

bodyTemplate.description: Handlebars template for the request body, populated with conversation context

endpoint.description: Target HTTP endpoint URL for http_api tools

headers.description: HTTP headers to include with each request as key-value pairs

mcpServerUrl.description: MCP server URL for mcp-type tools

parametersSchema.description: JSON Schema describing the parameters the tool accepts

description.description: Description of what the tool does and when the bot should use it

rateLimit.description: Maximum number of requests per minute allowed for this tool

name: neuron_create_tool
title: Create Tool
